create.name: Destiny Marie Love
create.bio:
Destiny Marie Love is a singer-songwriter, sound healer and yoga teacher who lives on the Big Island of Hawaii and teaches people to use their own voice, breath and sound to settle the nervous system. She has worked with voice and sound since 2009 and created Embodied Voice Healing, which draws on Nada Yoga, the yoga of sound, alongside toning, free-flowing song, breathing and gentle movement. She is a registered yoga teacher who has taught in Costa Rica and Oregon, and she is the author of Living as a Vessel, a memoir of turning hardship into embodied presence, and of Womb Codes for Spiritual Intimacy.

Much of her teaching happens online. Her self-paced voice and sound courses on Udemy have reached students in many countries, and she offers a free audio course on regulating the nervous system. Over video calls she gives one-to-one somatic voice mentoring, which can also cover songwriting and confidence for performing, and quieter inner-guidance sessions built on listening, breath and reflection. At home in Hawaii she and her husband, the musician Andrew Hanuman, lead song circles and group sound ceremonies of toning, harmony and prayer, and she shares her devotional songs and guided practices on YouTube.

courses.title: Somatic Voice Mentorship
courses.description: Online one-to-one sessions of 75 minutes that begin by settling the body and then follow what the voice needs that day: toning, breath, movement, improvised song or songwriting. Booked as a three-month package of six sessions, or as a single first session that can be credited towards it.

courses.title: Inner Guidance Mentorship
courses.description: Quiet, reflective one-to-one conversations by video or phone for times of transition, loss or spiritual change, drawing on breath, silence, voice and somatic awareness from her yoga and Taoist practice. Offered as a three-month package or a single first session.

courses.title: Embody Your Voice: The Yoga of Sound
courses.description: Her self-paced Udemy course on using the voice for self-healing through sound and the practices of Nada Yoga, aimed at opening creative expression. It is one of several voice courses she sells on Udemy.

courses.title: Embodied Voice Sound Ceremonies
courses.description: Group sound ceremonies that she leads with her husband Andrew Hanuman, weaving breath, vocal toning, intuitive movement, harmony and prayer into a shared field of sound. They also hold regular song circles on the Big Island.

free_resources.title: Free Nervous System Regulation Audio Course
free_resources.description: A free audio course of short somatic, breath and voice practices for releasing tension and coming back into the body, opened with a free access pass from her site.
